curiosities: GS stands for graphics and sound; its Ensoniq sound chip has 32 oscillators.
The first units carried Steve Wozniak's signature on the front.
It runs almost all software for the earlier Apple II models.
Its processor is a 65C816 at 2.8 MHz.
GS/OS gave it a desktop much like the Macintosh's.
It introduced the Apple Desktop Bus, later used by Mac keyboards and mice.
Apple stopped making it in December 1992.
